title: "Night of Sacrifice"
next_chapter_hook: "The moment Chen Nian opened her eyes, the chess game meticulously woven by Chen Ji truly revealed its most terrifying aspect—Heavenly Fate is not dead, the Eye of Heaven's Dao has never left."

text.content: "The altar of the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds loomed like a slumbering beast, glowing with an eerie bronze sheen under the moonlight. The moment Chen Ji stepped onto the stone stairs, a sharp pain pierced his chest—that was the Tianji Record frantically devouring his Heavenly Fate Value. The price of feigning death was heavier than he anticipated. But he couldn't stop, couldn't fall. His younger sister was still deep within the altar."

dialogue.content: "(Secret Voice) "All preparations are complete, three hundred death warriors in position. How are things on your end?" Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist formed a natural barrier at the outer edges of the forbidden land, but her voice carried a hint of tension that Chen Ji could clearly discern."

text.content: "Chen Ji did not respond. He sat cross-legged in a shadow at the edge of the altar, his breath so faint it was nearly nonexistent. To outsiders, this waste of a disciple from the Tianqing Sect had already breathed his last. Only he himself knew that his consciousness was connected to Ye Qing's soul through the Tianji Record, like controlling a precise puppet."

"The sacrifice ceremony began. The Holy Sect's priests, draped in blood-red robes, pushed living people toward the blood pool at the altar's center. Chen Ji saw those contorted faces—some struggling, some despairing, most already numb. He counted the time, waiting for the optimal moment for Ye Qing to strike."

dialogue.content: "(Secret Voice) "The three at the southeast corner are the strongest. Take them out first. Remember, saving lives is secondary, delaying the ceremony is key." Chen Ji's consciousness in the darkness was like a calm chess player, every move completed within the Tianji Record's calculations."

text.content: "Ye Qing struck. The Demonic Path mist surged into the altar like a tide, and three hundred death warriors emerged from the shadows like ghosts. The Holy Sect's guards had no time to react—the three masters at the southeast corner were instantly suppressed by Ye Qing's demonic energy. The ceremony's officiant on the altar screamed in terror."

"Chen Ji's consciousness trembled slightly—he saw a blurred image in the Tianji Record. Chen Nian was directly below the altar, a hundred zhang deep, suspended by chains in the center of a massive formation. Her face was pale as paper, yet a faint smile hung at the corner of her mouth, as if saying: "I knew you'd come."

dialogue.content: "(Secret Voice, gasping) "Found her! But there's a restriction, I need time—" Ye Qing's voice suddenly cut off, replaced by a piercing alarm. Through the Tianji Record, Chen Ji sensed the Holy Sect's true trump card appearing: an elderly man in golden robes stepping out of the Void."

text.content: "Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master! Chen Ji's heart sank. For this old thing to personally oversee the sacrifice ceremony meant they had long sensed the danger. Was it a trap, or a coincidence? The Tianji Record's visions suddenly twisted violently—he sensed that Chen Nian's presence was interfering with the prophecy."

choice.prompt: "The appearance of the Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master caused the situation to reverse abruptly. Ye Qing's situation became perilous. Continue executing the plan as planned, or personally intervene to break the deadlock?"

choices.text: "Trust and let go, letting Ye Qing decide for herself"
choices.description: "Ye Qing is the Demonic Path Saint. Her experience and judgment are not inferior to Chen Ji's. Breaking the death-feigning state now would expose everything—better to let her take the risk."
choices.visible_cost: "Bear the possible risk of Ye Qing's failure"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain the death-feigning identity, maximizing hidden trump cards"
choices.risk_hint: "If Ye Qing fails, Chen Nian may fall into enemy hands again"

text.content: "Chen Ji gritted his teeth, pouring all of the Tianji Record's perception into his connection with Ye Qing. He chose to trust—this woman who had been exploited by the Holy Sect for half her life would never let him down."

choices.text: "Issue precise remote commands through the Tianji Record"
choices.description: "Chen Ji had a thorough understanding of the battlefield. He transmitted every detail he saw in the Tianji Record—the Heavenly Fate Sect Master's technique flaws, the death warriors' blind spots—to Ye Qing, using information disparity to compensate for combat power gaps."
choices.visible_cost: "Consumes a massive amount of Heavenly Fate Value"
choices.visible_reward: "Ye Qing obtains crucial intelligence, successfully suppresses the Sect Master"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate Value loss accelerates, death-feigning state may end prematurely"

text.content: "The Tianji Record flashed frantically, countless visions flooding Chen Ji's mind. He endured the soul-tearing agony, precisely transmitting every flaw coordinate to Ye Qing. "Left rib, three inches, force not fully gathered—now!"

choices.text: "Break the death-feigning state, personally join the battle"
choices.description: "The Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master is a half-step Transformation God realm expert—Ye Qing is no match. Chen Ji had no choice but to intervene personally, even if it meant exposing that he never truly died."
choices.visible_cost: "The death-feigning plan completely fails, all arrangements may be exposed"
choices.visible_reward: "Personally save Chen Nian, shocking all enemies present"
choices.risk_hint: "Lose the greatest advantage of playing the fool to devour the tiger, drawn into higher-level power struggles"

text.content: "Chen Ji's eyelids trembled slightly. He couldn't wait any longer. Just as he was about to forcibly awaken, the Tianji Record suddenly transmitted a vision—Chen Nian was facing his direction, slowly shaking her head."

"Chen Nian's shake of the head made Chen Ji's heart tighten with alarm. She was clearly trapped within the formation—how could she perceive his intentions? Unless—that identity of Heavenly Fate's Lock Key was far more complex than he imagined."

dialogue.content: "(Secret Voice, excited) "It worked! The old fool took the bait, chasing west!" Ye Qing's voice carried the relief of surviving a near-death experience. The flaw coordinates Chen Ji had transmitted just now had saved her life; otherwise, she would have died under that golden-robed elder's palm long ago."

text.content: "But the crisis was not over. Chen Ji sensed that the formation where Chen Nian was located was accelerating its运转, as if the priests had sensed something amiss and wanted to forcibly initiate the sacrifice before reinforcements arrived. Hundreds of blood-red light pillars shot into the sky, shrouding the altar in an ominous crimson glow."

choice.prompt: "The sacrifice ceremony is about to forcibly initiate! Ye Qing is still evading pursuers, Chen Nian hangs by a thread. Every choice may determine her survival."

choices.text: "Order Ye Qing to attack with everything she has"
choices.description: "Have Ye Qing abandon all顾虑 and rush directly to Chen Nian's location. No matter what the cost, she must rescue her before the ceremony completes."
choices.visible_reward: "Highest probability of successfully rescuing Chen Nian"
choices.risk_hint: "May expose all of Ye Qing's trump cards"

text.content: "Don't worry about the pursuers, go save her directly!" Chen Ji's voice was cold and resolute. He didn't care what Ye Qing would face; he only cared whether Chen Nian could get out alive."

choices.text: "Use the Tianji Record to interfere with the sacrifice formation"
choices.description: "The sacrifice formation operates on the Tianji Record Fragment. As the holder of the Tianji Record, Chen Ji can use resonance to reverse-interfere with the ceremony, buying time for the rescue."
choices.visible_reward: "Let the enemy witness with their own eyes how a "dead man" turns the tables"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly raised his right hand toward the altar. The Tianji Record manifested brilliant light in his palm, producing violent resonance with that blood-red formation. The priests惊恐地发现 the ceremony was losing control."

"The formation trembled violently, cracks spreading like a spider's web. The priests screamed in terror, unable to understand why their power would suddenly turn against them. Seizing this opportunity, Ye Qing transformed into a black shadow, lunging toward Chen Nian's location."

"Chen Ji felt a剧烈眩晕. The resonance between the Tianji Record and the formation was devouring his Heavenly Fate Value like crazy, as if an invisible hand was tearing at his soul. But he didn't stop, because he saw Ye Qing's figure appear before Chen Nian."

dialogue.content: "(Secret Voice, trembling) "Found her... found her! She's still alive! But—" Ye Qing's voice suddenly choked. Chen Ji's heart sank as he used every ounce of strength to maintain the Tianji Record's connection, wanting to see Chen Nian's condition."

text.content: "The vision transmitted through the Tianji Record made Chen Ji's blood run cold. On Chen Nian's bare back, a jet-black rune squirmed like a living thing, spreading from her spine to her limbs. It was an ancient restriction—the "Heavenly Fate Soul-Binding Seal"! Once triggered, she would become a puppet of Heaven's Dao forever."

dialogue.content: "(Weak) "Brother... don't worry about me... that thing... will expose you..." Chen Nian seemed to sense something, struggling to open her eyes, revealing a pale smile toward the void. Her voice was as thin as a thread, yet it clearly entered Chen Ji's mind."

text.content: "Chen Ji's heart felt like it was being gripped by an invisible hand. His younger sister, at such a moment, was still thinking of protecting him? His eye sockets stung, but he suppressed all emotions, responding in the most calm tone: "Don't talk. Brother is taking you home."

"Ye Qing hesitated no more. She scooped up Chen Nian, activating all her demonic power, tearing a passage through the formation's cracks. Chen Ji's consciousness began to blur—the loss of Heavenly Fate Value made his soul like a dying candle in the wind. But he didn't close his eyes, staring fixedly at Ye Qing's escape route through the Tianji Record."

""Stop them! That's the Holy Sect's sacrifice!" The Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master finally reacted, his golden robes fluttering, striking toward Ye Qing with a palm. Chen Ji's pupils constricted, about to act, when Chen Nian suddenly extended her hand from Ye Qing's embrace, pointing at the golden-robed elder."

"The restriction rune on Chen Nian's back suddenly erupted with blinding black light. The Heavenly Fate Sect Master's movements froze instantly, his face contorting with disbelief—heavy fear. It was suppression from the law of Heaven's Dao, the instinctive counterattack of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Her body trembled, yet icy words spilled from her mouth: "Touch a single hair on her, and I'll trap you here forever."

dialogue.content: "(Secret Voice, shocked) "What... what kind of power is this?" Ye Qing had never witnessed such a bizarre scene. A frail woman, merely with one restriction, suppressed a half-step Transformation God realm expert?"

text.content: "Chen Ji gazed at Chen Nian's pale yet stubborn face in the Tianji Record, his heart bleeding. She had been tortured beyond recognition, yet was still using her last strength to buy him escape time. This was his sister, that little girl who had always trailed behind him shouting \"Big brother is the best.\""

choice.prompt: "Chen Nian displayed the terrifying power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, successfully suppressing the Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master. But each activation of this restriction consumes a portion of her life force. Should she continue suppressing the enemy, or conserve her power?"

choices.text: "Have Chen Nian stop using the restriction"
choices.description: "Chen Ji's protective instinct toward family made it impossible for him to watch his sister consume her life. He ordered Ye Qing to retreat immediately, even if it meant losing the chance to kill the Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master."
choices.visible_cost: "Loses the opportunity to severely wound the enemy"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master may escape"
choices.process_label: 妹妹的命比什么都重要

text.content: ""Enough!" Chen Ji's voice echoed within the Tianji Record, "Conserve your energy, we're retreating!" Upon hearing this, Chen Nian's body trembled slightly, a hint of grievance flashing in her eyes, yet she obediently withdrew the restriction's power."

choices.text: "Have Chen Nian completely suppress the Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master"
choices.description: "This is a rare opportunity. With the Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master trapped, this is the best chance to eliminate the threat permanently. Chen Ji made the painful decision to have Chen Nian use the restriction's full power."
choices.visible_cost: "Chen Nian's life force will significantly drain"
choices.visible_reward: "Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master will be permanently sealed"
choices.risk_hint: "Chen Nian may be left with permanent aftereffects"

text.content: ""Hold on a bit longer." Chen Ji's voice was cold and resolute, "Leave him here forever." Upon hearing this, a complex emotion flickered in Chen Nian's eyes, yet she gritted her teeth and pushed the restriction's power to its limit."

"Ye Qing vanished into the Demonic Path mist with Chen Nian. By the time the Heavenly Fate Sect's Sect Master broke free, there was no one before him. He roared toward the heavens, his voice full of不甘 and rage. But Chen Ji could not concern himself with this—his consciousness was fading within the Tianji Record."

"When Chen Ji "awoke" again, he found himself lying in an unfamiliar stone chamber. Ye Qing sat beside him, exhaustion mixed with侥幸 on her face. And Chen Nian lay on a stone bed not far away, the black runes on her back slightly writhing."

dialogue.content: "(Softly) "She keeps calling your name... How long are you going to keep pretending to be dead?" Ye Qing looked at Chen Ji, her eyes shimmering with complex emotions. This man had been deceiving her from start to finish, yet she simply couldn't hate him."

text.content: "Chen Ji did not answer. He stumbled to Chen Nian's bedside, grasping his sister's icy cold hand. That hand had once been plump and fair; now only skin remained over bone. His eye sockets finally reddened, his voice hoarse beyond recognition: "Xiao Nian, brother is late."

dialogue.content: "Chen Nian's eyelashes trembled slightly. She slowly opened her eyes, her pupils reflecting Chen Ji's pale face. After a moment of silence, she spoke her first words upon awakening in a voice as thin as a dying breath—words that sent Chen Ji into an icy abyss."

text.content: ""Brother... Heavenly Fate is still alive." Chen Nian's voice came in fragments, each word like a sledgehammer pounding Chen Ji's heart, "He's at the core of the Eye of Heaven's Dao... has been watching us... watching you..." Having said this, she fell unconscious again."

"Chen Ji's hand froze in mid-air. Heavenly Fate—that previous holder of the Tianji Record who should have died in the heavenly tribulation, that pitiful person whom Chen Nian said was \"devoured by Heaven's Dao\"—was actually still alive? And at the core of the Eye of Heaven's Dao? So all of Chen Ji's arrangements over these years had been under that person's surveillance from the beginning?"

"Silence filled the stone chamber. Ye Qing watched Chen Ji's骤然苍白的 complexion, wanting to ask, yet not knowing where to begin. Chen Ji simply sat quietly by Chen Nian's bedside, holding her hand, his gaze as deep as two dry wells. He had maneuvered the world, his plans flawless, yet he never imagined—from the very beginning, he was someone else's chess piece."

"Outside the window, the horizon brightened. A new day was about to dawn, yet Chen Ji felt unprecedented cold. The Tianji Record in his arms pulsed with warmth, as if reminding him—this fragmented volume was far more dangerous than he imagined. Was it the key to truth, or another trap set by Heaven's Dao's will?"

"Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, pressing all emotions into the deepest recesses of his heart. When he opened them again, those eyes had recovered their usual calm and profound nature. Whether Heavenly Fate lived or not, whatever secrets the Eye of Heaven's Dao held—he would unravel them all. Because he was Chen Ji, the chess master who rose from trash, the man destined to defy heaven and change his fate."
